objective.jobToBeDone: Review the full project record, track task and cost progress, inspect change orders, and generate or review AI delay-risk suggestions — all from a single workspace anchored to the project.
objective.primaryDecision: Is this project on track? — assessed by reading project status/schedule, scanning overdue tasks, evaluating change-order cost impact, and acting on delay-risk suggestions.
decisiveInfo: name, status, budget, startDate, endDate, holdReason (project anchor)
workTasks: title, assignedWorkerId, status, dueDate (task health)
changeOrders: title, costAdjustment, scheduleAdjustmentDays, status (financial risk)
changeOrderDetail: costAdjustment vs projectBudget, impactType, approvedAt (cost impact)
timeLogs: hoursWorked, laborCost, status (labor cost burn)
materialUsages: materialName, quantity, unitCost, status (material cost burn)
delayRiskSuggestions: riskLevel, reason, workTaskTitle, suggestedAction (AI advisory)
objective.usageFrequency: Occasional to frequent — project managers open this workspace during planning, status-report cycles, and when reviewing flagged risks.

criticalActions.presentation: contextual-transition-actions — a prominent 'Generate Risk Analysis' button scoped to the selected status report, placed inline with the delay-risk panel
master-detail — selecting a change order row opens the cost-impact detail panel inline without navigation
summary-first filterable table with status and due-date columns surfacing overdue flags

informationHierarchy: 1. Project header — client, site, schedule, budget, status (anchor for all analysis)
2. Task timeline — filterable work-task list showing assignee, status, due date, overdue flag
3. Change orders — filterable list + inline detail panel for cost/schedule impact
4. Cost tracking — time logs (labor) and material usages (materials) in a tabbed or stacked cost view
5. Delay-risk insights — AI suggestions panel with trigger action and acknowledgement filter
objective.successCriteria: A PM can assess project health, identify at-risk tasks, understand cost impact of change orders, and generate/review delay-risk suggestions without leaving the page or navigating to separate screens.
antiPatterns: Separate full-page form for change order detail — use inline master-detail
Status <select> for lifecycle transitions — show allowed next-state buttons only
Manually typed projectId, changeOrderId, or statusReportId — all are context-derived
One independent section per query — fold filters into their surface organism
Showing all enum values for status filter — default to most useful subset
Persuasion mechanics or urgency framing on this operational screen
